item.title: I Told Old Zhang His Rust Service Might Be 10x Slower - He Almost Spit Coffee in My Face
item.description: Rust service suddenly 10x slower? The problem might be hiding in Serde macros. This article walks through a real story to help you identify and fix performance issues caused by Serde serialization.
